subject: Emergency midday rate-tier swap, prorated credit & PO timing
messages:
From: Elena Torres <elena.torres@fastcommerce.com>
To: lauren_bishop@redwood.com
Date: 2026-11-22T10:12:00-08:00
Subject: URGENT: midday traffic spike — request to elevate rate tier for 48h + credit

Hi Lauren,

We just flipped a promotional campaign and are seeing an unexpected spike in inference traffic — roughly 6x our baseline over the last 45 minutes. We’re pegged against our current rate tier and are getting throttled. Can Redwood temporarily elevate us to the next rate tier for roughly 48 hours (starting as soon as possible) so we can ramp the campaign to completion?

Key asks:
- Immediate elevation of rate limit / throughput slab for 48 hours.
- Pro-rated fee for the uplift (we’ll accept a short-term uplift charge) and a one-time credit applied against any overrun beyond our monthly commit (we’ll need something documented for finance).
- We will issue a PO; need confirmation of the fields you require and expected invoice timing so our procurement can match it to the PO.

Estimate: the spike is about +12M tokens over two days. I’ve attached a quick usage snapshot.

Attachments: usage_snapshot_nov22.png (png)

We appreciate quick confirmation — campaign windows are tight.

Thanks,
Elena
Elena Torres
Head of Integrations, FastCommerce
elena.torres@fastcommerce.com
+1 415-555-0117
From: lauren_bishop@redwood.com
To: Elena Torres <elena.torres@fastcommerce.com>
Cc: aditya_rao@redwood.com, monica_patel@redwood.com
Date: 2026-11-22T10:28:00-08:00
Subject: Re: URGENT: midday traffic spike — request to elevate rate tier for 48h + credit

Hi Elena — thanks for the heads up and the snapshot.

We can support a temporary uplift but need to coordinate pricing and procurement fields. Internal next steps below; I’ve looped in Aditya (pricing/sales) and Monica (ops) to confirm capacity and draft the billing language.

From our side we need:
- Exact start/end timestamps for the uplift window (UTC preferred).
- PO number (or confirmation it will follow within 24 hours).
- Billing contact and billing email for the invoice.

Aditya / Monica — can you propose a short uplift pricing option (pro-rated) + one-time credit language for overrun above their monthly commit? Also confirm ops can flip the tier immediately and any expected propagation delay.

I’ll coordinate the PO fields with Elena once you confirm.

— Lauren
Lauren Bishop
Sr. Account Executive, Redwood Inference
lauren_bishop@redwood.com
From: aditya_rao@redwood.com
To: lauren_bishop@redwood.com
Cc: monica_patel@redwood.com
Date: 2026-11-22T11:05:00-08:00
Subject: Re: URGENT: midday traffic spike — request to elevate rate tier for 48h + credit

Quick proposal for the uplift and credit:

Pricing proposal (short-term uplift):
- Immediate elevation to the next throughput slab for a fixed 24h block priced at $5,000 per block (pro-rated for partial 24h).
- We can chain two blocks for up to 48h.

Overrun credit:
- If overrun (actual usage above monthly commit) occurs during the elevated window, Redwood will apply a one-time credit equal to 25% of the overrun charge on the next invoice.
- Credit applies only to overrun tokens attributable to the elevated window (we will reconcile against timestamps).

Procurement/PO:
- Required PO fields: PO number, billing contact name, billing email, billing address, expected invoice remit-to (ACH/wire/credit card).
- We can accept a preliminary PO number in email and finalize with the formal PO within 48 hours.

Notes:
- We will need a signed SOW addendum only if the uplift extends beyond 7 days; 48h is fine with an email confirmation + PO.
- Adding pricing_sheet_proposal.xlsx for your reference (contains sample proration math).

Monica — confirm backend toggle/propagation time; can you also paste any runbook requirements we should send to FastCommerce?

- Aditya
Aditya Rao
Lead Account Manager, Redwood Inference
aditya_rao@redwood.com
From: monica_patel@redwood.com
To: lauren_bishop@redwood.com, aditya_rao@redwood.com
Date: 2026-11-22T13:40:00-08:00
Subject: Re: URGENT: midday traffic spike — request to elevate rate tier for 48h + credit

Capacity and ops notes: we can flip the routing policy to the elevated slab immediately; propagation to all edge nodes typically completes within ~6–10 minutes. A few operational points:

- We will enable the elevated tier at the requested start time and schedule an automatic rollback at the provided end time; please confirm both timestamps in UTC.
- There is no SLA change for requests during the elevated window, but there is higher chance of transient throttling if the client continues to spike beyond the new slab — recommend they keep a graceful retry/backoff.
- Required fields for automated billing match Aditya’s list.
- I’m attaching a short runbook with the toggle steps and the engineering contact (change_runbook.txt).

Suggested language for email confirmation/finance: 
"Redwood will provide a temporary elevation to the next throughput slab for the period [start] to [end]. Customer will be billed for the uplift on a pro-rated basis per 24-hour block. Any token overrun attributable to the elevated window will be eligible for a one-time credit of 25% applied to the subsequent invoice."

If that wording looks good, we can apply the uplift once we receive: start/end UTC timestamps and either a PO number or a confirmation that the PO will be posted within 24 hours.

-Monica
Monica Patel
Technical Program Manager, Redwood Inference
monica_patel@redwood.com
From: Elena Torres <elena.torres@fastcommerce.com>
To: lauren_bishop@redwood.com
Cc: ops@fastcommerce.com
Date: 2026-11-23T15:02:00-08:00
Subject: Re: URGENT: midday traffic spike — request to elevate rate tier for 48h + credit

Lauren / Aditya / Monica — thanks for the quick turnaround and clear terms. We accept the pricing proposal and credit terms.

Confirmed window (UTC): 2026-11-22T18:30:00Z to 2026-11-24T18:30:00Z (48 hours).
PO: procurement will issue PO_12345.pdf within the hour and route to billing@fastcommerce.com; the PO will include the billing address and remit info.

Please proceed with the uplift at the start time. We’ll monitor and keep you updated if traffic continues to escalate. Please confirm when the uplift has been applied and whether the credit will appear as a line item on the next invoice (so our finance team can reconcile).

Attachment: PO_12345.pdf (pdf)

Regards,
Elena
